cnc01_treatment: Retain source-attested Liang/Jordan/Klein 2010 ancestry with the identity-safe non-DOI node; do not invent a DOI.
mem01_treatment: Retain source-attested Lebiere 1999 blending ancestry with the identity-safe non-DOI node; do not invent a DOI.
opaque_identity_policy: If sources attest shared ancestry but do not provide enough exact bibliographic fields for identity-safe resolution, retain an explicitly unresolved opaque bibliographic ancestor; never erase the ancestry and never manufacture an identifier.
